source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-38

procedures.title: Hard top vinyl covering: remove
steps: Loosen the cemented edges of the fabric roof cover.
notes: Caution: heat with lamps kept at least 18 inches away, only until the fabric is warm. Lamps too close or fabric over 200°F can lose its grain, blister or turn very shiny.
Figure 67 in the manual (Molding and Weatherstrip) fills most of this page: exploded hard top weatherstrip and molding layout, views A-D.
